subject: Quick check: security packet review + next demo slot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ortiz <alex.ortiz@cloudreef.com>, Priya Sen <priya@cloudreef.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick check: security packet & next steps (post-demo)

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really appreciated the candid feedback on latency targets and the multi-tenant isolation requirements. Per our call, I’m attaching the security packet we discussed and a short SOC 2 summary that answers the typical procurement/legal questions up front.

Attachments:
- redwood-security-packet-20261117.pdf (PDF, 2.4MB) — full evidence bundle and architecture notes
- SOC2-summary-20261117.txt (plain text) — scope, auditors, controls mapped to common questions

Quick recap / next steps I noted from the call:
- Priority: CloudReef is targeting a pilot in Q1; procurement will need the security packet by end of Nov to hit internal timelines.
- Blockers flagged: data residency, tenant isolation assurances, and encryption-at-rest key management (you mentioned KMS/HSM preference).
- Ask from Redwood: would your team want an on-call technical walkthrough with our infra engineer? We can also prepare a short one-page attestation for in-region hosting.

Proposed short next steps (pick what works):
1) Share packet with legal/procurement (done — attached).
2) 30-min technical review with Ops + Infra (I’m free Thurs 11/19 10–11am PT or Mon 11/23 1–2pm PT).
3) If procurement needs a written attestation, we can produce an in-region deploy note and KMS configuration excerpt within 48 hours.

Let me know who on your side should be looped into the technical review and which slot (or send two alternatives). If you want Ben (our Solutions Engineer) to lead the deep-dive, he’s on CC.

Best,

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126

Subject: Re: Quick check: security packet & next steps (follow-up)

Hey Alex/Priya — just bumping this in case it got buried. Marissa shared the packet last week (attached again). Wanted to check if there are any blockers from procurement/legal so we can prioritize follow-up items from our side.

If it helps, Ben (me) can do a short 20–30 min tech session that focuses only on the items procurement flagged:
- VPC / in-region deployment options and data residency
- KMS/HSM key management and rotation notes
- Audit logs and retention windows (we keep immutable traces for the duration you require; we can scope retention by region)

I have two open windows next week for a focused session: Wed 11/25 9–9:30am PT or Tue 12/1 2–2:30pm PT. If neither works, happy to send a one-page attestation and a short recording that goes through the architecture diagrams.

No problem if your team is still reviewing — just trying to avoid last-minute procurement crunch.

Thanks,

From: Alex Ortiz <alex.ortiz@cloudreef.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sen <priya@cloudreef.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick check: security packet & next steps

Hi Marissa / Ben — sorry for the radio silence; procurement pulled the packet into a review earlier this week and legal raised a couple of items we need clarified before we can move the pilot forward. I attached our internal note with the specific questions.

Top questions they asked (short):
- Can Redwood guarantee in-region hosting for all pilot data (we're focused on US-West region)? If yes, do you provide a signed attestation for that capability?
- What are the default retention windows for audit logs? Legal is asking whether we can limit retention to 90 days for the pilot (we may extend later).
- KMS: do you support customer-managed keys (CMK) in our cloud account, or would Redwood manage keys in your KMS? We prefer CMK if possible.

Those are the things blocking procurement sign-off right now. If you can confirm the hosting attestation and the KMS options, we should be able to proceed. We appreciate the packet — it helped a lot.

We can do a quick 20-min call next week to run through answers and sign off if that’s simpler. Our preference: Tue 12/1 11am PT. Can you make that?

Thanks,
Alex Ortiz
Director of Engineering | CloudReef
alex.ortiz@cloudreef.com | +1 206-555-0210

<cloudreef-security-questions-20261127.pdf attached>
